dataset.label_positive_meaning: radiologist high-suspicion category in LIDC-IDRI (NOT pathology-confirmed)

encoding.method: angle_i = 2*arctan(x_i)  (maps standardized features to (-pi, pi) without clipping)

circuit.output: raw_score = P(odd parity of 4 measured bits)

noise.label: noiseless
noise.source: hypothetical simulator sweep (not derived from hardware calibration data)

mitigation.method: tensored readout-error mitigation (per-qubit 2x2 calibration matrices, inverted)
mitigation.targets: measurement (readout) errors only; does NOT address gate or decoherence errors
mitigation.assumption: readout errors are independent across qubits (true for this simulator model)
mitigation.nonphysical_policy: mitigated scores are reported RAW, even outside [0, 1]; never clipped
mitigation.calibration_prep_caveat: the X gates used to prepare |1111> are themselves noisy under gate-noise settings, so preparation error is absorbed into the calibration

outputs.score_definition: raw_score = P(odd parity of the 4 measured bits); NOT a calibrated probability

noisy_exact.note: infinite-shot noisy expectation (gate noise via density matrix, readout analytic)

mitigated.note: raw mitigated estimates; values outside [0,1] are kept, not clipped

state_diagnostics.note: per-qubit Bloch vectors of reduced states; entanglement alone shortens them; NOT a confidence or reliability measure; readout mitigation does not change the state

dataset.dataset_version: pylidc 0.2.3 annotation DB; no CT pixel data used
dataset.label_definition: median of >=3 readers' malignancy ratings (1-5): >3 -> 1, <3 -> 0, ==3 excluded
dataset.label_positive_meaning: radiologist high-suspicion category in LIDC-IDRI (NOT pathology-confirmed)

encoding.method: angle_i = 2*arctan(x_i)  (maps standardized features to (-pi, pi) without clipping)

circuit.output: raw_score = P(odd parity of 4 measured bits)

noise.label: gate + readout (high)
noise.source: hypothetical simulator sweep (not derived from hardware calibration data)

mitigation.method: tensored readout-error mitigation (per-qubit 2x2 calibration matrices, inverted)
mitigation.targets: measurement (readout) errors only; does NOT address gate or decoherence errors
mitigation.assumption: readout errors are independent across qubits (true for this simulator model)
mitigation.nonphysical_policy: mitigated scores are reported RAW, even outside [0, 1]; never clipped
mitigation.calibration_prep_caveat: the X gates used to prepare |1111> are themselves noisy under gate-noise settings, so preparation error is absorbed into the calibration

outputs.score_definition: raw_score = P(odd parity of the 4 measured bits); NOT a calibrated probability

noisy_exact.note: infinite-shot noisy expectation (gate noise via density matrix, readout analytic)

mitigated.note: raw mitigated estimates; values outside [0,1] are kept, not clipped
